note: Places added after the numbered pin map. They have no number: the map pin says "New". A place gives either `pixel` (the spot marked on the official map, apps/visitor-web/public/maps/damsen-map.jpg, 2048x1315) or `latitude`/`longitude` (then the pixel is derived). Position and entrance node are computed by data/walkways-new/build_graph.py; names and colours are the project team's.
